applicability: Checking pressure-edge migration and rocking onset in the exact pad fixture before articulated support experiments
Distinguishing a near-edge loaded contact from a robust support margin
claim: In the exact certified L3.2 free unary pad fixture, the predicted contact-pressure center moves monotonically toward the support edge; the 0.21 meter force-application offset remains supported at 93.1 percent of the edge, while 0.24 meters rocks beyond it, bracketing the analytic 0.2235 meter threshold with a mirrored negative repeat.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact L3.0-L3.2 free unary loaded-pad observations named by the source-pinned programs. The force-controlled carriage is an explicit apply_force boundary and not a rail; centered normal loading, loaded shear breakaway, predicted contact-pressure edge migration, and rocking retain their declared fixture, load, geometry, material, timestep, and solver scopes. It establishes no general contact wrench, per-contact or per-foot load allocation, articulated load-bearing limb, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The declared free unary pad moves predicted contact pressure toward the analytic edge and brackets rocking between 0.21 and 0.24 m application offsets around the 0.2235 m threshold, with a mirrored negative repeat.

failure_boundaries: The force-controlled carriage is an explicit external load boundary and supplies no hidden balancing moment
Predicted pressure migration is not a general contact wrench or a per-foot allocator
No articulated load-bearing limb, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, or walking is established
mechanism: The offset imposed force contributes a declared moment while gravity acts through the pad center. Their analytic resultant moves toward the finite support edge; predicted contact pressure tracks that movement until the resultant crosses the boundary and the unconstrained pad rocks.
scope: Only the exact free unary pad geometry and mass, 40 newton imposed normal force, signed application-offset grid, force-controlled carriage boundary, material, timestep, solver configuration, pressure estimator, thresholds, and program claim scope certified by br3b_20260723T103240Z_f5f54a58.
